name: Exercise Date 1 Choice
definition: Choice between a known exercise date and a pending date.

FirstExerciseDate.name: First Exercise Date
FirstExerciseDate.definition: Specifies the earliest unadjusted date during the exercise period on which an option can be exercised.|||Usage|: For European style options, the first possible exercise date is the same as the ExpirationDate.||For American style options, the first possible exercise date is the same as the ExecutionTimeStamp.||For Knock-in options, the first exercise date is reported when available.

PendingDateApplicable.name: Pending Date Applicable
PendingDateApplicable.definition: Indicates that price is currently not available, but pending.
